column3: NASB follows the critical text; “lepta” is rendered “small copper coins.”

NASB lacks “here,” found only in some manuscripts; “thrown down” is rendered “torn down.”

NASB renders “was saying” as “continued by saying.”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “an opportunity for.”
NASB follows the critical text; “implant in your hearts” is rendered “make up your minds.”

NASB follows the critical text; “avenging” is rendered “vengeance.”
NASB follows the critical text; it renders “distress” as “dismay” and “rolling surge” as “the waves.”
